correctness.rationale: For all integer \(n\ge3\), connectedness makes every nonzero \(F^3\)-fixed coloring a fully advancing phase word. The explicitly defined left boundary vector, 81-state transfer M and terminal vector enumerate those words for all \(n\ge4\). Direct inspection of every tuple establishes the exact integer identity \((M^3-3M^2+2M-2I)r=0\), and initial counts 6,18,42,102 establish the recurrence from \(n=6\). The independent direct simulator checks 265707 states for \(3\le n\le11\). Finite computation is used only for a fully exhausted 81-case identity, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: Finite open radius-two chains are a natural minimal extension of noncyclic nearest-neighbor chains that can support a permanent three-color excitation clock. A concise cubic recurrence and rational generating function for all initial primitive three-periodic states, together with the exact growth rate and exponentially rare density, supply a nontrivial motivated orbit population invariant for all chain lengths. The proof exhibits a substantial collapse from an 81-state finite-range transfer to a three-term law.
